ModMetaData.name: Taller Shelves
ModMetaData.author: Greg Stevenson
ModMetaData.description:
Adds two new storage buildings, Tall Shelf and Tall Shelf (small): taller versions of the vanilla shelves that hold twice as much per cell. Unlocked with a new "Taller Shelving" research project.

Pure XML mod, no assemblies, no dependencies - just two buildings bolted onto vanilla's own shelf system. If you want bigger shelves without pulling in a whole storage framework, this is a lightweight alternative to bigger furniture packs like "[sbz] Neat Storage".

Safe to add/remove mid-save.
